items.exampleEn: Metal gets hot in the sun.
Please put the empty bottles in this box.
items.exampleZh: 請把空瓶子放進這個箱子。

items.exampleEn: Basically, he is a nice person.
Ancient people used stones as tools.
items.exampleZh: 古代的人用石頭當工具。

items.exampleEn: The fields turn golden in the autumn.
items.exampleZh: 秋天時田野變成一片金黃。

items.exampleEn: My first car was a used one.
items.exampleZh: 我的第一輛車是二手的。

items.exampleEn: Keep raw meat separate from other food.
items.exampleZh: 生肉要和其他食物分開放。

items.sentenceEn: The fridge is empty. Let's go shopping.
items.sentenceZh: 冰箱空了，我們去買東西吧。

items.audioEn: I bought a used bike for only five hundred dollars.
items.audioZh: 我只花五百元就買了一輛二手腳踏車。

items.sentenceEn: We visited an ancient temple in Japan.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在日本參觀了一座古老的寺廟。

items.sentenceEn: Basically, you just need to follow these three steps.
items.sentenceZh: 基本上，你只要照著這三個步驟做就好。

items.stemEn: My brother and I don't share a room. We sleep in ____ rooms.
items.stemZh: 我和弟弟沒有住同一間，我們睡在不同的房間。

items.stemEn: Put the photo in a ____ and put it on your desk.
items.stemZh: 把照片放進相框，擺在你的書桌上。

items.passageEn: Last month, my family moved into an old house. Basically, it was empty when we arrived. In the garden, we found an old metal box. Inside, there was a golden ring and a photo in a small frame. The photo showed a family from long ago. We put the ring and the photo in separate bags and took them to a museum. Then we bought some used furniture for the house.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們家搬進一間老房子。基本上，我們到的時候房子是空的。我們在花園裡發現一個舊的金屬盒子，裡面有一枚金戒指和一張裝在小相框裡的照片。照片裡是很久以前的一家人。我們把戒指和照片分別裝進不同的袋子，送到博物館去。接著我們為房子買了一些二手家具。

questions.questionZh: 他們在花園裡發現了什麼？
他們把戒指和照片送到哪裡？

referenceEn: This cup is made of metal.
rubricZh: 「⋯做的」可寫例如 is made of metal

referenceEn: This shop only sells used clothes.
This store sells only used clothes.
rubricZh: 用 used 表示「二手的」，放在名詞前（例如 used clothes）
only 可放在動詞前或後（例如 only sells、sells only 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：ancient metal box 裡有一張照片（photo from long ago），照片最多一兩百年，用 ancient（古代、上千年）不合邏輯；建議改 old，或盒中不放照片。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last month, my family moved into an old house. Basically, it was empty when we arrived. In the garden, we found an old metal box. Inside, there was a golden ring and a photo in a small frame. The photo showed a family from long ago. We put the ring and the photo in separate bags and took them to a museum. Then we bought some used furniture for the house."（原 "Last month, my family moved into an old house. Basically, it was empty when we arrived. In the garden, we found an ancient metal box. Inside, there was a golden ring and a photo in a small frame. The photo showed a family from long ago. We put the ring and the photo in separate bags and took them to a museum. Then we bought some used furniture for the house."）；ancient 另有單字卡、跟讀與 mcq

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：短文 ancient→old，正解用字同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["一隻小狗","一個舊的金屬盒子","一棵老樹"]（原 ["一隻小狗","一個古老的金屬盒子","一棵老樹"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：題目要說「你買過或想買的二手東西」，參考答案 Used books are cheap at this shop. 沒有說到自己買過或想買，不符題目要求。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "I want to buy a used camera."（原 "Used books are cheap at this shop."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：後期規則補正：mcq 干擾項——混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格：basically 放不進 in a ___，改名詞 pocket，連同 metal 共兩個干擾項文法成立
